exposure: Phthalate metabolites (MMP, MEP, MBP, MEOHP, DEHP metabolites)
cohort: The study included 3240 singleton mother-infant pairs from the Ma'anshan Birth Cohort.
finding: The study found trimester- and sex-dependent effects of prenatal phthalate exposure on childhood allergies, with various phthalate metabolites exhibiting nonlinear dose-response relationships and critical windows of exposure.
